cases.sentence: Вот видишь это большое строение? Это новая ___.
options: больница
больницы
больнице
больницей
cases.translation: Do you see that large building? That's the new hospital.
cases.explain: «Больница» is the predicate noun after «это», so it stands in the Nominative case.

options: Анна
Анны
Анне
Анной
cases.explain: «Анны» shows possession of «руку» ("Anna's hand"), hence Genitive.

cases.sentence: «Вы забываете вашу обязанность», — сказала она вышедшему тоже на крыльцо ___.
options: Весловский
Весловского
Весловскому
Весловским
cases.translation: "You are forgetting your duty," she said to Veslovsky, who had also come out onto the porch.
cases.explain: «Весловскому» is the indirect object of «сказала» ("said to someone"), hence Dative.

cases.sentence: он ... еще раз поздоровался с Дарьей Александровной и теперь поцеловал ее ___.
options: рука
руки
руке
руку
cases.translation: he greeted Darya Alexandrovna once more and now kissed her hand.
cases.explain: «Руку» is the direct object of the transitive verb «поцеловал», hence Accusative.

cases.sentence: говорила она, с той радостно-хитрой ___, с которою часто говорят женщины о тайных свойствах любимого человека.
options: улыбка
улыбки
улыбке
улыбкой
cases.translation: she said, with that happily sly smile with which women often speak of the secret virtues of a loved one.
cases.explain: The preposition «с» governs the Instrumental case: «с ... улыбкой».

cases.sentence: Он даже скуп в ___, но только в этом.
options: хозяйство
хозяйства
хозяйству
хозяйстве
cases.translation: He is even stingy in running the estate, but only in that.
cases.explain: The preposition «в» (sphere/location) governs the Prepositional case: «в хозяйстве».

reading.ru: Анна смотрела на худое, измученное, засыпавшуюся в морщинки пылью лицо Долли и хотела сказать то, что она думала, именно что Долли похудела.
reading.question: What did Anna almost say to Dolly at the start of the chapter?
options: That Dolly had grown thin
That Dolly looked wonderful
That Dolly should rest before talking
That Dolly had arrived too late
reading.explain: Anna looked at Dolly's thin, exhausted, dust-creased face and wanted to say what she was thinking — that Dolly had grown thin.

reading.ru: Ну и что ж, стыдно признаться, но я, я непростительно счастлива.
reading.question: What did Anna confess about her own happiness?
options: That she was, shamefully, unforgivably happy
That she had never been more miserable
That she felt nothing at all
That her happiness depended entirely on Vronsky's mood
reading.correct: That she was, shamefully, unforgivably happy
reading.explain: Anna admits, though ashamed to say it, that she is unpardonably happy.

reading.ru: «Как я рада», — улыбаясь, сказала Долли, невольно холоднее, чем она хотела.
reading.question: How did Dolly respond to Anna, despite her intentions?
options: She said she was glad, but more coldly than she meant to
She burst into tears of joy
She refused to respond at all
She warmly embraced Anna without words
reading.correct: She said she was glad, but more coldly than she meant to
reading.explain: Dolly says smiling that she is glad, but the text notes it came out involuntarily colder than she intended.

reading.ru: «Отчего? Оттого, что я не смела. Ты забываешь мое положение».
reading.question: Why did Anna say she had not written to Dolly?
options: Because she did not dare, given her position
Because she had lost Dolly's address
Because Vronsky forbade it
Because she was too busy with the estate
reading.correct: Because she did not dare, given her position
reading.explain: Anna explains she did not write because she did not dare, reminding Dolly of her position.

reading.ru: «Это что же эти все строения?» — спросила она, желая переменить разговор и указывая на красные и зеленые крыши, видневшиеся из-за зелени живых изгородей, акации и сирени.
reading.question: What did Dolly ask in order to change the subject?
options: What all the buildings with red and green roofs were
How far it was back to the Levins' estate
Whether Vronsky was happy
When dinner would be served
reading.correct: What all the buildings with red and green roofs were
reading.explain: Wanting to change the subject, Dolly asked about the buildings whose red and green roofs showed through the greenery.

reading.ru: «Если у тебя есть грехи, — сказала она, — они все простились бы тебе за твой приезд и эти слова».
reading.question: What did Anna say about Dolly's visit and her words?
options: That if Dolly had any sins, they would all be forgiven for her visit and her words
That Dolly's visit meant nothing to her
That she wished Dolly had not come at all
That she needed Dolly to visit more often
reading.correct: That if Dolly had any sins, they would all be forgiven for her visit and her words
reading.explain: Anna tells Dolly that if she had any sins, they would all be forgiven for her coming and for these words.

reading.ru: И Долли видела, что слезы выступили ей на глаза.
reading.question: What did Dolly notice about Anna after their emotional exchange?
options: Tears had come to Anna's eyes
Anna had turned away angrily
Anna had started laughing
Anna had fallen silent for a long time
reading.correct: Tears had come to Anna's eyes
reading.explain: Dolly saw that tears had come to Anna's eyes after she spoke.

reading.ru: Все это было запущено, но Алексей все возобновил.
reading.question: What had Vronsky done with the neglected estate?
options: He had restored everything that had fallen into neglect
He had sold off most of the land
He had left it exactly as it was
He had built an entirely new estate elsewhere
reading.correct: He had restored everything that had fallen into neglect
reading.explain: Anna explains that everything had been neglected, but Alexei had restored it all.

reading.ru: И чего я никак не ожидала, он страстно увлекся хозяйством».
reading.question: What surprised Anna about Vronsky's involvement with the estate?
options: That he had passionately taken up managing it
That he had lost all interest in it
That he had hired a manager instead
That he complained about it constantly
reading.correct: That he had passionately taken up managing it
reading.explain: Anna says that, to her surprise, Vronsky became passionately absorbed in running the estate.

reading.question: What was the large building Anna pointed out to Dolly?
options: A new hospital
A new stable
A guest house
A schoolhouse
reading.explain: Anna points out the large building and identifies it as the new hospital.

reading.ru: Мужики у него просили уступить им дешевле луга, кажется, и он отказал, и я упрекнула его в скупости.
reading.question: What incident led Anna to accuse Vronsky of stinginess, prompting him to build the hospital?
options: The peasants asked him to let them have the meadow more cheaply, and he refused
He refused to pay his workers a fair wage
He would not lend money to a neighboring landowner
He refused to fund a new church
reading.correct: The peasants asked him to let them have the meadow more cheaply, and he refused
reading.explain: Anna recounts that the peasants had asked to rent the meadow more cheaply, he refused, and she reproached him for stinginess, which led him to build the hospital to prove otherwise.

reading.ru: «Как хорош», — сказала Долли с невольным удивлением, глядя на прекрасный с колоннами дом, выступающий из разноцветной зелени старых деревьев сада.
reading.question: How did Dolly react to seeing the manor house?
options: She exclaimed with involuntary admiration at how beautiful it was
She thought it looked run-down
She said nothing at all
She compared it unfavorably to her own home
reading.correct: She exclaimed with involuntary admiration at how beautiful it was
reading.explain: Dolly exclaimed, with unwilling admiration, how beautiful the house with its columns looked among the old garden trees.

reading.ru: — Где вы поместите княгиню? — сказал Вронский по-французски, обращаясь к Анне, и, не дождавшись ответа, еще раз поздоровался с Дарьей Александровной и теперь поцеловал ее руку.
reading.question: What did Vronsky ask Anna, and what did he then do?
options: He asked where they would put the princess, then greeted Dolly again and kissed her hand
He asked when dinner would be ready
He asked Anna to fetch the horses
He ignored Dolly entirely and spoke only to Anna
reading.correct: He asked where they would put the princess, then greeted Dolly again and kissed her hand
reading.explain: Vronsky, speaking French, asked Anna where they would lodge Darya Alexandrovna, then greeted her again and kissed her hand.

reading.ru: «Ты надолго ли? На один день? Это невозможно».
reading.question: How did Anna react when she learned how long Dolly planned to stay?
options: She protested that staying only one day was impossible
She said one day was more than enough
She was relieved Dolly could not stay longer
She did not react at all
reading.correct: She protested that staying only one day was impossible
reading.explain: Anna exclaims that a stay of only one day is impossible.

reading.ru: И эта комната, за которую надо было извиняться, была преисполнена роскоши, в какой никогда не жила Долли и которая напомнила ей лучшие гостиницы за границей.
reading.question: What was the room Anna gave Dolly actually like, despite Anna's apology for it?
options: It was filled with luxury Dolly had never experienced, reminiscent of the finest hotels abroad
It was small and plain, as Anna had warned
It had no windows and felt cramped
It was still under construction
reading.correct: It was filled with luxury Dolly had never experienced, reminiscent of the finest hotels abroad
reading.explain: The room Anna apologized for was in fact full of a luxury Dolly had never lived in, recalling the best hotels abroad.

reading.ru: «Мы прекрасно живем у Левиных», — прибавила она.
reading.question: What did Dolly say about her family's stay with the Levins?
options: That they were living very well there
That they were eager to leave
That the Levins had been inhospitable
That she missed her own home terribly
reading.correct: That they were living very well there
reading.explain: Dolly adds that they were living splendidly at the Levins'.
